The Salesforce sync skipped updated opportunities again. Our pipeline report was wrong.
We cannot trust the Salesforce integration because records arrive hours late.
Duplicate contacts keep appearing after the Salesforce sync.
The integration failed during our quarter-end reporting process.
We are considering canceling because the Salesforce data cannot be trusted.
Our sales team stopped using FlowPilot after another failed sync.
The Salesforce connection drops without warning and requires an admin to reconnect it.
Account ownership changes are not reflected correctly after syncing.
The sync works most days, but the failures are serious when they happen.
We lost confidence in the dashboard because Salesforce totals do not match.
After the latest update I cannot log in on mobile unless I reinstall the app.
Mobile login stopped working this week. Desktop is fine.
The app keeps sending me back to the login screen after the update.
Face ID no longer completes login on iOS.
Our field team cannot sign in on mobile since version 3.8.
The mobile app says my session expired immediately after I log in.
Several employees reported the same mobile login loop this morning.
Android login started failing after the most recent release.
Contractors can see projects they should not have access to.
We need role-based permissions before we can roll this out to more departments.
Admin controls are too basic for a company our size.
We need separate permissions for viewing, editing, and exporting data.
The lack of audit logs is blocking our security review.
Managers need access to team dashboards without seeing individual compensation data.
We cannot expand beyond one business unit until permissions improve.
Please add approval controls for external collaborators.
Setup was surprisingly easy. We had the whole team working in one afternoon.
The templates helped us launch our first workflow quickly.
I understood the basics without needing a demo.
The onboarding checklist was clear and useful.
Connecting the first data source was confusing and I almost gave up.
I could not tell which setup step was required versus optional.
The tutorial assumes I already understand workflow automation.
Setup was easy, but inviting teammates was harder than expected.
The sample project made the product click for me.
I needed support to finish setup, but the support response was excellent.
We need more dashboard templates. I do not know which reports leadership actually needs.
Please add a weekly executive report template.
I want a template for board reporting, but I am not sure which metrics matter.
The reports show a lot of data but do not tell me what needs attention.
Can the product recommend which KPIs to track for a SaaS company?
I need a simple way to explain project health to leadership.
More templates would help, but the real problem is choosing the right measures.
I spend too much time deciding which charts belong in a client update.
The reporting builder is flexible, but I do not know where to start.
A guided report based on my business goal would be more useful than another blank template.
Large projects take too long to load during our Monday planning meeting.
The dashboard becomes sluggish when we filter more than six months of data.
Exports sometimes time out for our largest workspace.
Search is noticeably slower than it was last quarter.
The app freezes briefly when several teammates update tasks at once.
Performance is fine for small projects but degrades as our workspace grows.
I was charged for a seat that had already been removed.
The upgrade screen does not clearly explain annual versus monthly pricing.
We need consolidated billing across multiple workspaces.
The invoice does not include the purchase order number our finance team requires.
The free-to-paid transition was confusing and we were surprised by the first bill.
The shared workspace finally replaced three different spreadsheets for our team.
Comments and mentions make handoffs much clearer.
Support responded within an hour and solved the issue immediately.
The project templates save us several hours every month.
Our weekly planning meeting is shorter because everyone sees the same status.
The collaboration features are the main reason we renewed.
The support team explained the workaround clearly and followed up afterward.
We use the shared timeline with every client now.
The product is becoming the operating hub for our delivery team.
